checkpoint: g1-wild-01 seed 1 (hnet_ws + byte match model, L03, 908 steps; val bpb 1.502); the closest trained relative of g4-combo-02 on this box
data: 64 windows x 8512 bytes spread over mix_v1 val (first 512 bytes of each window dropped from the statistics), 512,000 scored bytes; training-side probes on 160 windows of mix_v1_small train shard 1

where_the_bits_are.note: per-byte CE of the trained model split by the length of the chunk-in-progress prefix (0 = predicting the first byte of the next chunk) and by whether the byte match model's candidate is right

rows.group: chunk start, copy wrong or none
inside chunk, copy wrong or none

readout_capacity_at_chunk_starts.note: correction head f([main_out, h_final]) added to the frozen logits at chunk starts, fitted on 302,523 training chunk starts, evaluated on 122,675 val chunk starts (best epoch)
readout_capacity_at_chunk_starts.verdict: killed: a higher-capacity chunk-start output path reading the same state can add at most ~0.01 bpb, part of which the trie's empty-prefix rows already provide

chunk_keyed_copy_at_chunk_starts.note: in-window match keyed by the last k chunks (variable length, the learned unit); candidate = byte after the most recent earlier chunk end with the same key; fitted logit bonus per (k, agreement with the byte match) on half the windows, evaluated on the other half
chunk_keyed_copy_at_chunk_starts.verdict: killed: the trained model already predicts what a chunk-keyed copy offers

count_based_output_memories.note: R most frequent (key, next byte) pairs from 30 MB of mix_v1_small train (router boundaries emulated by a count model of the checkpoint's router: precision 0.92, recall 0.84 on val), mixed with the model by EM-fitted weights per (log count, chunk start); gain on the held-out half
count_based_output_memories.verdict: an n-gram-count memory adds nothing to the trained model; the learned trie's measured -0.025 is 8x the count bound of its own key, so the trie works as an output embedding scored against the main network's state, not as a count memory. Cross-chunk (previous chunk) trie keys dropped: no evidence for them

frozen_backbone_trie.note: trie head trained on cached features of 200 training windows (1.6M positions), evaluated on 48 val windows
frozen_backbone_trie.verdict: uncalibratable at CPU data scale: 5M table parameters memorize 1.6 MB; not used for decisions

memory_slot_usage.note: fresh 96^2-slot product-key memory read from the residual stream before main layer 2 (2 windows); distinct slots out of 9216 vs ~9216 for uniform random reads
memory_slot_usage.decision: query centering by a running mean (persistent EMA buffer, no within-batch coupling); usage at init is limited by the fresh main network's low-rank stream and is the main risk (logged as memory/slots_used)

table_ablation: logbook/evolve/candidates/g5-output-02/budget_probe.json (mean-ablation per table on the same checkpoint)
